subject: [PATCH v2 3/4] kernfs: don't hold kernfs_rwsem across dir_emit()

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the kernfs directory handling to release a lock (kernfs_rwsem) before emitting directory entries to userspace, preventing potential deadlocks under memory pressure. The previous commit had already removed the re-locking of this semaphore in kernfs_fop_readdir(), but this patch goes further by releasing it around the dir_emit() function call. This change ensures that a listing is no longer atomic within one getdents(2) call, aligning with POSIX's unspecified behavior for entries added or removed since opendir(3). The fix addresses an issue where monitoring daemons would fault on their own getdents(2) buffer while holding the lock, leading to page allocation stalls.
